correctness.rationale: For an absolutely continuous bivariate sample, conditioning gives \(a_n=nE[F(Z)^{n-1}]\). On \(X<1\), the contribution is at most \(n(1-e^{-1})^{n-1}\). On \(X\ge1\), the published CDF simplifies exactly to \(1-A(w)e^{-X}\) with \(A(w)=1+w(e^w-1)\). Direct integration in \(e^{-X}\) gives \([1-(1-A/e)^n]/A\), bounded by one and converging to \(1/A\); dominated convergence proves the limit. The inequality \(e^w-1>w\) gives the rigorous bound below \(\pi/4<0.8\). The packaged verifier independently rechecks the numerical integral and finite-\(n\) identity.
